title: Liposomal NMN Reviews: Is GenF20 NAD+ Supplement Safe?
abstract:
##### Liposomal Carrier System  
Stomach acids hinder NMN absorption; therefore, Liposomal NMN supplement uses a Liposomal coating that acts as a carrier for β-Nicotinamide Mononucleotide (NMN). This unique delivery mechanism causes substances such as NMN to absorb better in your system.
##### β-Nicotinamide Mononucleotide (NMN)  
Each serving of Liposomal NMN (every capsule) contains 250 mg of pure 98% β-Nicotinamide Mononucleotide (one of the best purity ratings in the market right now). They determined this amount to be the best for boosting NAD+ and improving its effectiveness.  
Every serving of Liposomal NMN supplement is protected by a liposome. This fatty molecule creates a coat around NMN and keeps this molecule safe in the stomach, therefore improving its absorption before dissolving in the stomach acids.  
NMN, commonly referred to as a NAD precursor, has recently been the attention of anti-age researchers. They are hoping for an advanced science like curing chronically-ill people using this ingredient. According to Dr. Christopher W. Shade People can’t take NAD straight because it is huge; therefore, they have to take a precursor, one of which is NMN.  
Recently, an exciting animal study showed that Nicotinamide mononucleotide (NMN) supplementation could lead to neurovascular rejuvenation in aged mice with mitochondrial improvement, plus anti-inflammatory, and anti-apoptotic results. Another similar research indicated how [long-term administration of NMN](https://www.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/pmc/articles/PMC5668137/) can rectify age-associated physiological changes in mice.
##### Q: How can you describe NMN?  
**A:**NMN (β-Nicotinamide Mononucleotide) is a precursor of NAD+, and the human boy requires this ingredient to produce NAD+. By providing the body with enough NMN, you increase NAD+ levels which, according to recent findings, determine your REAL biological age.
